name: The Dead
overview: Scripture teaches that the dead are silent and inactive, having no knowledge or ability to praise God, as seen in Psalms 115:17 and Ecclesiastes 9:5. The spirit returns to God who gave it, while the body returns to the earth (Ecclesiastes 12:7), emphasizing the finality of death. God forbids seeking communication with the dead or familiar spirits, warning against practices such as necromancy and consulting wizards (Leviticus 19:31; Deuteronomy 18:11). This underscores that prayer and worship belong to the living, who alone can respond to God.
